extraction: Unmodified arXiv LaTeX source tarball for Koposov et al. 2019, MNRAS 485, 4726, 'Piercing the Milky Way: an all-sky view of the Orphan stream'. Source of the six transcribed stream_koposov2019_* tables.
note: main.tex holds 8 table environments; each target table is contained in a SINGLE environment (verified by verify_koposov_rows.py), so the split-table failure mode does not apply here. Numeric row counts in the source are 8 / 10 / 8 / 0 / 14 / 12 / 12 / 10 and the transcriptions reproduce them exactly. Table 4 (RR Lyrae) is printed in truncated form -- its full 109 rows are the VizieR record J/MNRAS/485/4726/table15, acquired separately.
